activation_boundary: Separate CLEAN independent rereview plus explicit final block authority and integration are required; current human authority pins are absent and opening denies before private-map read.
allowed_claim: Disabled provider-free v2 producer evidence closes P0/P1 locally; no activation, live/countable result, human authority, or provider/add-on conclusion.

close_p0.grades: Every grade binding seals the pre-call packet hash, opaque alias, commitment binding, evaluation packet hash, base grade hash, and role.
close_p0.metrics: The metric binding seals the same commitment, all ordered packet hashes, ordered grade-binding hashes, aliases, and derived-metric hash.
close_p0.opening: Reads receipt+commitment only; rejects fixture, noncountable, or unpinned authority; revalidates all packet/grade/metric bindings; only then reads the private map and checks every alias-to-cell pair exactly.
close_p0.pre_call_packets: Each exact frozen cell packet carries one immutable opaque alias and the exact transaction ID, receipt ref, sanitized commitment ref, canonical digest, and canonical bytes.

close_p1.marker: Create/fsync/reopen the strict receipt last; readers accept only its exact complete pair; remove stages with parent fsync.
close_p1.namespace_commit: Hard-link each stage to its no-replace final name, fsync parent after each namespace commit, and exact-readback both finals.
close_p1.preflight: Recover/quarantine recognized markerless/invalid residues and verify both final namespaces plus receipt before staging.
close_p1.recovery: On zero/short/write/fsync/link/conflict/readback/cleanup failure, remove or quarantine all recognized partial stage/final/marker artifacts and fsync; a deterministic retry is not blocked.
close_p1.staging: Create complete private-map and commitment stage files with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW, full-write loops, 0600 mode, file fsync, directory fsync, and exact reopen/hash.

failure_radius: Fixed ignored v2 runtime root and provider-free in-memory binding objects only.

state_authority.human_opening: externally pinned live countable registry only; currently absent
